talk_track.claim: “3D Systems is a major competitor in this space.”
talk_track.counter: In demand generation they are effectively absent. Zero LinkedIn marketing creative for two consecutive runs, and their only paid footprint is 26 Google ads from two APAC reseller accounts. They are not contesting the market with marketing.

talk_track.claim: “3D Systems leads in Med Tech, Dental, and Aerospace.”
talk_track.counter: Those are stated verticals with effectively zero paid support behind them. Their observable advertising sells jewelry wax patterns and mould cost reduction in Korea and Japan. Ask what they are actively investing in versus what is on the website.

talk_track.claim: “3D Systems is a safe long-term partner.”
talk_track.counter: The CEO search opened Aug 4 and remains unresolved with no successor named. Raise continuity of support and roadmap ownership over a multi-year program.
True, and worth respecting. The $9M USAF follow-on and the NAMI licence are real. They win through contracts and JVs, not marketing, so contest those on programme terms, not on share of voice.

exposure: Aerospace and defense programme wins. They are converting through contract awards and joint ventures, which our ad tracking cannot see. This is the blind spot on this competitor.
APAC jewelry and dental resale. A small but defended niche where they hold local reseller relationships.

watch.b: Watch revenue against the $96M to $99M guide, any go-to-market reorganisation, and aerospace and defense commentary.

watch.h: Whether the US Google account grows
watch.b: 9 ads is a test. If it grows, or LinkedIn creative follows, 3D Systems is back in western demand gen and belongs higher in the tracker.
This is where they actually compete. Aerospace and defense wins, certifications and JV announcements matter far more than their media.
Still live for a third run. Minor, but it is a fair, checkable data point about operational attention.
A new CEO usually resets go-to-market. Watch for the appointment and any marketing reorganisation after it.

spend_method: Dollars are derived at render time by tools/spend_model.py, never stored.
